snippet.title: Stormforge - Official Playtest Announcement Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Don't miss the Playtest Announcement Trailer for Stormforge, an open-world survival crafting game developed by Roboto Games. Players will harness the power of magical storms to fight, craft, and slay difficult bosses. Endure the storm in Stormforge, coming soon to PC (Steam), with sign-ups for the upcoming Playtest available now on Steam.
